guarantees.claim: prng_data_permuted is assigned as a bit-permutation of prng_data according to the constant index array RndCnstLfsrPerm.

uncertain_points.claim: If any entry in RndCnstLfsrPerm is greater than or equal to the bit width of prng_data, then the corresponding prng_data_permuted bit becomes X due to out-of-bounds selection.
uncertain_points.cond: When RndCnstLfsrPerm is legally set to such an index.
uncertain_points.risk: X propagation in the entropy permutation output can weaken or invalidate the random number quality, impacting downstream security functions.
